question:
“Swadesh Sevak Home” is related to which of the following national freedom

 initiatives?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ghadar Movement**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The "Swadesh Sevak Home" was established in the United States and Canada during the early 20th century to promote revolutionary activities against British rule in India.
 
• It served as a hub for Indian immigrants and revolutionaries involved in the **Ghadar Movement**, which aimed to overthrow British colonial rule through armed rebellion.
